answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 13024 Country: India Title: If we have to keep fast on 13,14,15 of each month is it OK to follow calender date as we don?t know moon seen or not or there any source or web site from which we can check it? Question: If we have to keep fast on 13,14,15 of each month is it OK to follow calender date as we don?t know moon seen or not or there any source or web site from which we can check it? Answer ID: 13024 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 810/770=B/1430) The calendar date is generally correct, but sometimes it is different too; therefore it is better to confirm the same with any local religious alim . However, every Muslim should be aware of the lunar calendar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
